description: Return a deterministic VideoSpec skeleton. This tool does not generate creative copy or write files.

acceptedDesign.description: The design the user accepted. Returned in planningContext for later steps; it does not change the VideoSpec.

body.description: Accepted body copy. It replaces the placeholder copy and appears once.

brief.description: Original intent and constraints to preserve through planning and handoff. This is not generated video copy.

cta.description: Accepted call to action for the closing scene.

mediaSrc.description: Source video path for the video window in qa-ad and social-remix. Other templates ignore it; without it the spec holds a placeholder path.

title.description: Video title, shown in the opening scene and used for the spec ID.
